findings.description: C-9 requires use of a humanizer audit-and-revise process, but its stated final-artifact style review cannot falsify or verify that process requirement.
findings.evidence: Inlined C-9 text requires every string to "goes through the humanizer skill's audit-and-revise loop," while its check only says to read the added prose against a pattern list and surrounding voice; prose could satisfy that review without the loop having occurred.
